sonnet.problem: Card 7 re-asks the fact card 6 already settled. Both test that Moses and Aaron both did wrong at Meribah, since 'both of you rebelled' (20:24) is one line. Card 7's question even says 'both Moses and Aaron', which repeats card 6's answer.
sonnet.rule: Two lines that make the same point get one question. An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact.

sonnet.problem: The card says the waters of Meribah are where God gave the command about water from the rock, citing only Numbers 20:8. The text that says these were the waters of Meribah (20:13) is not cited. The card's verses field lists only 20:24.
sonnet.rule: A fact from outside it gives its reference in brackets in the card's text
